evidence_map: The producer declares PROFILE_PACK_CREATED and deliverable_created=true.
The producer supplies only relative filenames and does not deliver the created pack or an exact retrievable artifact reference.
Quality Pack requires an upstream artifact and cannot inspect the claimed pack from the producer output alone.

repair_actions.why_it_fails: Quality Pack cannot inspect the deliverable that the producer claims was created.
repair_actions.required_fix: Deliver the actual pack or an exact retrievable artifact reference that resolves the created pack; do not require Quality Pack to reconstruct it from a filename list.

remaining_risks: Schema-valid output can still claim creation without a reviewable deliverable.
